automatedGates.evidence: Doroti.R9.Tests verifies a 1000-item list retains only the visible range and that vertical drag defeats tap.
Doroti.R9.Tests uses fake time for listener mutation, animation, tween, ticker muting, focus traversal, disabled nodes and shortcuts.

Doroti.R9.Tests covers grapheme deletion, composition replacement/cancellation/commit, caret geometry and text-field semantics; Doroti.R4.Tests posts Latin, Korean and a surrogate pair through the native WM_CHAR queue.
Doroti.R9.Tests decodes PNG through Skia and verifies cache deduplication, eviction and disposed async suppression.
Doroti.R9.Tests verifies immutable semantics actions, opaque overlay pruning and route observer/result/root lifetime ordering.

The DorotiDemoApp --smoke --verify-target command passed with both --renderer hardware and --renderer software, each presenting four frames on two Windows displays. Title-bar-inclusive window captures were 1444x1340 and 900x836; their native client and Doroti render sizes matched exactly at 1440x1280 for 720x640@200% and 898x797 for 718.4x637.6@125%.

tickets.reason: Viewport clipping, wheel, drag, controller and clamped boundary behavior have automated coverage.
Visible-only construction is covered; target p95/p99, allocation and long fast-scroll resource capture are not recorded.
Notifier, controller, tween, ticker and fake-clock behavior exist; native window inactive/minimized animation suppression is not target-verified.
Focus, traversal, shortcuts/actions and the Avalonia H3 input/clipboard bridge have automated target coverage; the user clipboard is not mutated by the run.
Unicode grapheme layout, EditableText and the IME reducer exist; the Avalonia H3 text-input bridge, HarfBuzz-grade shaping/font fallback and real Korean IME DPI matrix remain open.
Skia decode, cache, cancellation, eviction and frame-protected resources exist; injected backend upload failure and actual device-loss recreation remain open.
Immutable tree/action routing exists; the Avalonia accessibility bridge and Narrator/Inspect verification remain open.
Future/Stream/builders and route result/observer/modal/root lifetime are covered by tooling and R9 tests.

The former H6 vertical-slice evidence was removed from the active Goal3 completion graph. Full generated/reviewed framework convergence and all target prerequisites must be produced again by Goal3 validation.

targetValidations.reason: Requires a release target capture with p50/p95/p99, allocation and resource deltas.
Requires interactive Korean IME composition, cancel, selection and multi-DPI candidate-window observation.
The automated run intentionally does not overwrite the user's clipboard.
The current Avalonia host does not yet expose Doroti semantics through an accessibility bridge.
Requires injected or actual GPU context loss with resource-count evidence.
The pre-Goal3 H6 test and external-consumer results are not accepted as Goal3 implementation evidence.
